line: Don’t let these bitches use you Niggas and bitches, they just wanna use you
vault_lines: Don't let these bitches use you
meaning: Kodak pleads with listeners in hopes that we do not let our peers take advantage of us. Male and female counterparts can and will take advantage of you if you let it happen, kodak wants you to prevent this at all cost.

line: I’m on 5th Ave, flippin’ stones and trees, post up in Soulja Rees
vault_lines: I'm on 5th Ave, flippin' stones and trees, post up in Soulja Rees
meaning: I think it’s Soulja Rees, soulja being Soulja Slim who popularized reebok shoes (rees) in his music
